asset_heavy.reason: Cloud software and marketing services for small businesses; no plants, fleets or networks needed to grow.

big_ticket.reason: Monthly SaaS subscriptions and marketing services for small businesses are small, frequent purchases.

cyclical_demand.reason: Small businesses can cut discretionary marketing spend and subscriptions in a downturn; they are also vulnerable to failure.

large_customers.reason: Customers are small local service businesses such as roofers, law offices and landscapers.

notes: Thryv also still has a legacy print Yellow Pages directory business, which is smaller and not covered here.

offers_products.reason: Thryv SaaS platform: CRM, Marketing Center, Business Center, AI website builder and lead tools.

offers_services.reason: Done-for-you marketing services such as SEO/AEO, listings and ad campaign management for small businesses.

people_delivered.reason: Mainly a software platform with AI tools; the marketing services are a smaller part and rely on technology.

recurring_revenue.reason: SaaS subscriptions and ongoing monthly marketing service contracts with small businesses that renew.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells only to local service businesses, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are small local service businesses: home services, health, legal, insurance and pet services.
